page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The processor is equipped with a 504 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). This instance is configured with 248.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of 1745 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 5 local drives. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-threaded performance, placing in the top 10% for single-core Geekbench scores (2307.0) and single-threaded gzip compression (36.83 GB/sec). Multi-core capabilities are also strong, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 18257.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 53228.41, both ranking in the top 25%. Memory subsystem performance is characterized by a read-only large block bandwidth of 168.46 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 77.81 GB/sec. For database operations, the server achieves 62.26 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks, while static web serving throughput reaches 59.7 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of a high-capacity memory allocation and integrated local NVMe SSD storage provides a balanced hardware profile for memory-intensive and I/O-heavy workloads without requiring separate storage attachments. The presence of AMX instructions supports efficient local LLM inference, achieving 362.23 tokens per second for text generation on small 135M models. This server is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, data processing pipelines, and localized machine learning inference tasks.
